create_priority_queue: create a PriorityQueue instance with a custom max_size and optional tie_breaker generator
push_to_priority_queue: push data with an integer priority into the PriorityQueue using the push method
pop_from_priority_queue: pop the highest priority item from the PriorityQueue using the pop method
handle_empty_exception: handle the Empty exception when popping from an empty PriorityQueue
handle_full_exception: handle the Full exception when pushing to a PriorityQueue at max capacity
